<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 26px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">1、安装redis</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Redis 没有官方的Windows版本，但是微软开源技术团队（Microsoft Open Tech group）开发和维护着这个 Win64 的版本。</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">我下载的是2.8这个版本：</span><a href="https://github.com/MSOpenTech/redis/releases/tag/win-2.8.2104"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(0, 154, 97);">https://github.com/MSOpenTech&#8230;</span></a></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">下载后解压即可。我这里解压到D盘根目录：</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 30px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">1.1 启动redis服务端程序：</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">打开cmd命令，进入redis安装目录，运行以下命令：</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">redis-server redis.windows.conf</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 30px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">1.2 启动redis客户端程序</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">服务端程序启动后，不要关闭，双击redis安装目录下的redis-cli.exe，即可启动客户端程序</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 26px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">2、安装php-redis扩展。确认安装的版本</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">查看phpinfo里的信息，确认安装的版本，例如我的需要安装X64的TS版本。</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 30px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">2.1 安装redis和igbinary扩展</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">redis扩展下载地址：</span><a href="http://pecl.php.net/package/redis/2.2.7/windows"><span style="color: rgb(0, 56, 132);">http://pecl.php.net/package/redis/2.2.7/windows</span></a></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">下载并解压后，将php_redis.dll拷贝至php安装目录下的ext目录</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">打开php.ini文件，添加扩展：</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">extension=php_redis.dll</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 30px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">2.2 重启服务器</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">重启后，如果在phpinfo中看到redis版本信息，则代表php的redis扩展安装成功。</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">在根目录下新建redis.php，输入以下代码：</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(153, 153, 153); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold;">&lt;?php</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">$redis=</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold;">new</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> Redis();<br />
$redis-&gt;connect(</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(221, 17, 68); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#39;127.0.0.1&#39;</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">,</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(0, 128, 128); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">6379</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">);<br />
$redis-&gt;set(</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(221, 17, 68); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#39;name&#39;</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">,</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(221, 17, 68); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#39;hello,redis&#39;</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">);</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold;">echo</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> $redis-&gt;get(</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(221, 17, 68); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&#39;name&#39;</span><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">);</span></div>
<div yne-bulb-block="paragraph" style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">运行后，页面会打印hello,redis字符串。同时通过redis客户端，也可以获取该值。</span></div>
